semantic.justification: Actual single OlsonTimeZone owner: resource counts/buffers, canonical/final-zone state and lazy transition/rule cache; copy/assignment/clone/equality, historical/final offset dispatch, scalar field overloads, immutable raw-offset setter, current-clock/year queries, full next/previous/count/borrowed-rule contracts. Shared mapped-buffer identity and source assignment ID omission/null-map rule shortcut are retained (CALC-313/314); cache reset ownership finding extends CALC-308. The original fields and methods are split into implementation fragments solely for file-size limits; no parallel zone state or host timezone rule provider is used. Unchanged ICU78.3 libraries and pinned icudt78l.dat verify all639 system IDs, historical UTC boundaries/local mask midpoints, future/final transitions, field overloads, actual borrowed rules and Calendar wall-time completion via scripts/icu-olson-native-probe.mjs. Public custom/default factories, locale calendar construction, full LibreOffice calendar/formatter/CSV integration and native allocation/concurrency/ABI/undefined input behavior remain incomplete or uncertified.
